I should also think about the possibility that one of the drinks is a more obscure or regional cocktail that might not have much information online. In that case, relying solely on WebSurfer might not yield the necessary results, and maybe a different tool or method would be better suited.

So, considering all this, I think the planner's decision to use WebSurfer first might not be the most efficient or accurate approach. It could potentially miss information or take longer than necessary. Maybe involving another tool or a mixologist's expertise would be better.
